import React, { useState } from 'react';
import './Gallery.css';

const items = [
  { id:1, title:'Dal Lake at Dawn',   tag:'Srinagar',  span:'', img:'https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcQTCuX3J25x48P0zHwAUikirwRdhDmyZmfrvg&s' },
  { id:2, title:'Tulip Garden',       tag:'Spring',    span:'',     img:'https://etimg.etb2bimg.com/thumb/msid-99687781,imgsize-514806,width-1200,height=627,overlay-ettravel,resizemode-75/destination/states/srinagars-tulip-garden-witnesses-record-number-of-tourists.jpg' },
  { id:3, title:'Gulmarg Gondola',    tag:'Winter',    span:'',     img:'https://images.hindustantimes.com/rf/image_size_630x354/HT/p2/2020/10/06/Pictures/_08b3d9f2-07ec-11eb-bb5c-c76064722a88.jpg' },
  { id:4, title:'Pahalgam Valley',    tag:'Pahalgam',  span:'', img:'https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcTTxsCOjt9cIU6ObzraCwf92IdZM21H7VjxkQ&s' },
  { id:5, title:'Chinar in Autumn',   tag:'Autumn',    span:'',     img:'https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcQp1DoaoZaB7LRcID36VT14MbMbVPTBh5YWEA&s' },
  { id:6, title:'Sonamarg Glacier',   tag:'Sonamarg',  span:'', img:'https://www.tourmyindia.com/states/jammu-kashmir/image/thajiwas-glacier-sonmarg.jpg' },
  { id:7, title:'Wular Lake',         tag:'Bandipora', span:'',     img:'https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcT9pt7fkxG1OkO_iO3uoFDmgV2f5A3mFxUklw&s' },
  { id:8, title:'Old Srinagar',       tag:'Culture',   span:'',     img:'data:image/jpeg;base64,' },
  { id:9, title:'nishat garden',      tag:'Srinagar',     span:'', img:'data:image/jpeg;base64,' },
  { id:10, title:'badaamwari',        tag:'Peace in trees',    span:'',     img:'https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcRrKAKpM_IOcSNkBNjNcG9J6skyAeIzPzyYmg&s' },
  { id:11, title:'doodhpathri',       tag:'summer',    span:'',     img:'https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcRvWDRzG6ddVn0ug909YRSLwPstgkai5ItRZw&s' },
  { id:12, title:'Gurez valley',   tag:'nature at best',  span:'', img:'https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcRg95h68j2P2_rWNxc_4eo4e0H-2ypsZZaTCA&s' },
];

export default function Gallery() {
  const [hoveredId, setHoveredId] = useState(null);

  return (
    <section className="gallery" id="gallery">
      <div className="gallery-container">
        <div className="gallery-header">
          <p className="section-label">Visual Journey</p>
          <h2 className="section-title">Kashmir Through <em>the Lens</em></h2>
        </div>
        <div className="gallery-grid">
          {items.map((item) => (
            <div
              key={item.id}
              className={`gallery-item ${item.span}`}
              onMouseEnter={() => setHoveredId(item.id)}
              onMouseLeave={() => setHoveredId(null)}
            >
              <img src={item.img} alt={item.title} className="gallery-real-img" />
              <div className="gallery-dim" />
              <div className={`gallery-overlay ${hoveredId === item.id ? 'visible' : ''}`}>
                <span className="gallery-tag">{item.tag}</span>
                <h3 className="gallery-title">{item.title}</h3>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
     
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
